raw_blocks: Driving Sugar Supply Chain with Innovative Improvements
Investing in Supply Chain Innovation & Solutions.
From raw sugar to refined, to warehousing and freight, our fully integrated supply chain means more opportunities for market disruption and more supply chain alternatives that benefit our customers.
Unique Supply Chain Solutions and Distinct Customer Service
We’ve developed innovative supply chain solutions that lower costs and risks, and deliver enhanced service and options to customers.

Our original and creative strategies help to overcome traditional logistical challenges, and we are equipped to meet a variety of customer requirements from bulk railcars to smaller scale and specialty needs.
We are the only North American cane sugar refiner built with a focus on overall supply chain efficiency opportunities from origin all the way through to the customer.
Excellent Customer Service & Solutions
Sucro is a full service, cane refiner.
Sucro has plants strategically located through the North America heartland of food manufacturing.

Innovation is the driving force of our company. With SweetLife Services we offer supply solutions to the food manufacturing industry across multiple platforms, including facilities for processing and warehousing. SweetLife by Sucro™ also offers end-product conventional cane, organic sugar and other specialty sweetener products.

raw_blocks: Sucro’s success was all about CEO, Jonathan Taylor’s relentless pursuit of meeting the increasing needs of customers.

The sugar industry has been consolidating and limiting capacity expansion for years, despite the growing complexity and needs of food and beverage manufacturers. Mr Taylor recognized the market opportunity for a smaller, integrated, more flexible sugar refiner to provide innovative supply chain solutions.

The new company would do what others had not; it would lead through innovation and reinvestment, finding improvements throughout the entire supply chain. Through sheer determination and tenacious leadership, Mr Taylor has led Sucro to becoming the fastest growing sugar company in the North American sugar market, with plenty of growth ahead driven by exciting new projects.
Our mission is to be the leading alternative integrated sugar supplier in North America, leveraging our processing footprint and strategic partnerships to fully service sugar users.
Jonathan Taylor’s determination was molded during his modest upbringing in Mexico. His dedication to education would lead him to graduate with an economics degree from Cornell University.

Taylor’s career would soon lead him to the soft commodities industry where he gained 15+ years in sugar trading experience before starting Sucro. Taylor’s pride in his heritage inspired him to solicit Sucro’s certification as a minority-owned business in order to help grow the role for supplier diversity. Sucro is one of 13,000 U.S. businesses certified withThe National Minority Supplier Development Council Inc® (NMSDC®) offering products, services and solutions to companies committed to advancing minority-owned suppliers.
Launched in 2014, the Miami-based company has demonstrated significant growth creating value for customers, through continuous process innovation and supply chain re-engineering.

Strategically innovative investments have secured Sucro’s growth in the U.S. and abroad with operations in western NewYork, Illinois, Georgia, Ontario, Mexico, the Caribbean and South America.The company’s success is attributed toTaylor’s partnership with a highly qualified management team and key Directors who boast deep roots within the sugar industry, providing expertise and trusted leadership within the market.
Sucro is motivated to achieve further success, continuing to be a responsive listener to customers and a bold and innovative disruptor within the sugar industry.
15+ years of sugar trading experience (Formerly at large trading conglomerates)
Since 2014, sucessfully developed Sucro from ground up to a $400M business
Vice President and Head Trader
Over 15 years of commodity experience, with BP in London, Czarnikow Group Ltd in London,
Establishing Czarnikow in the Americas as Head Trader for Czarnikow Sugar Inc.
13+ years of US Food Manufacturing, Distribution, and M&A Experience
US Army Ranger, Engineer Captain; 2001 – 2009
Vice President, Sales & Operations – Canada
Joined Sucro in 2020 as Vice President, responsible for the Hamilton, Ontario and Lackawanna, NY operations.
25+ years experience in the food and beverage industry including 20 years in sugar/sweeteners.
Executive level experience in Sales, Operations and Supply Chain.
15+ years experience in the financial services industry, with expertise in compliance and internal controls
Joined Sucro in 2018, with transformational impact in cap structure and funding costs
